description: This file implements the CreditBureauReadConfigurationService interface, providing methods to read credit bureau configuration data from a database based on organization credit bureau ID, including retrieving configuration as a collection and as a map. It uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database operations and includes internal mapping logic.

classes.name: CreditBureauReadConfigurationServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service to read credit bureau configuration data from database, using Spring JdbcTemplate, and security context.

classes.name: CbConfigMapper
classes.description: RowMapper implementation for mapping SQL ResultSet rows to CreditBureauConfigurationData objects.

methods.name: CreditBureauReadConfigurationServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor injecting security context and jdbc template dependencies.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the SQL schema string used in queries for selecting credit bureau configuration fields.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL result row to a CreditBureauConfigurationData object.

methods.name: readConfigurationByOrganisationCreditBureauId
methods.description: Fetches a collection of credit bureau configuration data filtered by organization credit bureau ID.

methods.name: retrieveConfigMap
methods.description: Retrieves credit bureau configuration data as a key-value map based on organization credit bureau ID.
